regions.name: The Barrens
regions.hook: One road the length of a continent, a crossroads on it, and everything either side wants the road.

threat.text: Tier 1 north of the Crossroads, Tier 2 south of it, and Tier 3 at Razorfen Downs

weightClass.text: Chaff and Soldiers in the north — quilboar, centaur, raptors, and the Venture Company's crews. South of the Crossroads it is Standards, with one Elite per hold

heldBy.text: The Horde, along the road. A goblin port, an Alliance fort, a dwarf dig and a Venture Company operation all sit inside it and none of them answer to Orgrimmar

regions.hook: A plain given back nine years ago, and the people who took it are still on the edges of it.

weightClass.text: Chaff in packs — gnolls, prowlers, harpies off the ridge. Soldiers as quilboar where they have a ravine. The only Elite is a chieftain

heldBy.text: Thunder Bluff, and it is the safest province on either continent

regions.name: Desolace
regions.hook: A land the Sundering killed, and the centaur are still fighting over the corpse.

weightClass.text: Soldiers as centaur, in raiding parties, constantly. The khans are the Elites. One Boss underground at Maraudon and the province is the road to her

heldBy.text: Nobody. Two outposts on opposite coasts, and two centaur clans that hate each other more than either hates you

regions.hook: A nine-year-old human city-state with a black dragon nesting an hour south of it.

threat.text: Tier 2, and Tier 4 in the wyrmbog

weightClass.text: Standards as ogres and murlocs across the marsh. Elites at the ogre hold. One Boss in the wyrmbog and she is a dragon rather than a garrison

heldBy.text: Theramore holds the island. The Stonemaul ogres hold the mainland north. The wyrmbog holds itself

regions.hook: A country where the roads are on top of the rock, and there is a racetrack at the bottom.

weightClass.text: Soldiers as centaur and harpies. Elites on the pinnacles, where they are difficult to reach and know it. No Boss in the province

heldBy.text: Divided. The tauren hold one mesa, the goblins hold the salt flats, the centaur hold the canyons between

regions.hook: A city of the old empire still standing and still lit, and the ogres in the other nine tenths do not know what the library is.

threat.text: Tier 3, and Tier 4 inside Dire Maul

weightClass.text: Standards as gnolls and ogres, in numbers, across the whole province. Elites in the ruins. Three Bosses behind one wall at Dire Maul

heldBy.text: The Sentinels at Feathermoon and a Horde camp inland. The Woodpaw gnolls hold the south. Dire Maul is ogres, except for the wing that is not

regions.hook: A desert with one town in it that sells to both sides, and everything outside the walls is older than the desert.

weightClass.text: Standards as trolls and elementals, and both are organised. Elites in the pyramid. One Boss on top of it, in the open, where the Sandfury want it seen

heldBy.text: Gadgetzan is the Steamwheedle Cartel's. The Sandfury hold Zul'Farrak. The bronze dragonflight hold a cave and nobody enters it

weightClass.text: Standards as raptors, in numbers. The devilsaurs are Elites and there is no garrison anywhere to run to. The crater itself is the Boss

weightClass.text: Elites are the ordinary adversary here and Standards arrive as their escort, which is the reverse of everywhere else. One Boss behind a wall with a lock on it, and the lock is the province
